capabilities: Export a longform note to a compilable LaTeX document in-vault
Assemble content recursively via embeds from notes across the vault
Convert wikilinks, citations, and equation labels into LaTeX references
Export figures, LaTeX environments, sections, and abstract/appendix headers
Export a selected portion of a note to the clipboard
extras: Known limitations: tables and inline code are not supported, nested list parsing is limited. Under non-default settings, re-running the export overwrites the generated LaTeX file, so manual edits should be copied elsewhere first. An example vault and exported PDF are provided in the repository.
intentEvidence: Export to TeX: A very similar plugin. Latex Exporter seems to have more features in the export
motivation: The author wanted one unified workflow from ideation to final product inside Obsidian, so a paper can emerge organically from the graph of notes.
problem: Turning a graph of Obsidian notes into one polished LaTeX document is non-trivial, so writers fragment their work between Obsidian and tools like Overleaf.
